description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Resource_Extends class, which implements the resource handling for template extension in Smarty. It manages loading, timestamp population, content retrieval, and other operations related to extended template resources.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Extends
classes.description: A class handling extended resource templates in Smarty, supporting functionality like populating source metadata, managing timestamps, and retrieving template content.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata from the resource, including components, filepath, UID, and existence.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Assigns timestamp and existence flag to the source object based on its components.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads and concatenates the content of the template's source components into a single string.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns a basename for the resource, suitable for compiled filename identification.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Indicates whether timestamp checks are enabled; returns false for extended resources.
